title: Derived pullback of the inverse right unit with constant coefficients
statement: For every commutative coefficient ring A, scheme morphism f:X->Y, and unbounded complex K of A-module sheaves on Y, the inverse right unitor K -> K tensor A_Y commutes with derived inverse image, its canonical tensor comparison, and the prescribed constant degree-zero comparison [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. No torsion or invertibility hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Base-change compatibility of the defining components; monoidal unit step of lem-asd-finite-twist-derived-evaluation-pullback. See also Stacks Tag 06YU.

proof.text: Identify the constant coefficient sheaf in degree zero with the derived monoidal unit using singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Unfold the single-object derived comparison to identify genericConstantIso with leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso. The source theorem leftDerivedUpperStar_map_singleFunctorObjUnitIso_inv_comp identifies this map with the monoidal unit comparison. Naturality of the tensor comparison in the inverse unit identification and leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_rightUnitor_hom give the hom square. Cancel the invertible right unitor, use functoriality and the two inverse identities, and obtain the displayed inverse-right-unit square. Carry out this argument at abstract coefficients before specializing to ModuleCat, so that conversion never expands concrete sheafification data.

theorem ordinaryFiniteDerivedRightUnit_pullback
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map (derivedTensorSingleUnitIso K).inv ≫
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app K).app
          (ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y) ≫
        ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A X).obj ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj K)).map
          (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom =
      (derivedTensorSingleUnitIso ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj K)).inv)
